title: feat(nm2frm2ly): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then -e2 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Bare L-path (-e3,-e2), the opposite in-plane turn. Yields the same inverted pair as +e2 but with the failure moved to the origin instead of (0,1,0); the holder set is the largest of any L-path on this seed (8 sites).
